test_item_member_function: test that the item() member function is treated as an identity by the compiler for graph generation
create_random_variable_beta: create a random variable using the bm.random_variable decorator that returns a Beta distribution
create_random_variable_flip: create a random variable using the bm.random_variable decorator that returns a Bernoulli distribution from beta().item()
generate_dot_graph_before_transform: generate a DOT graph representation of random variables using BMGInference to_dot with after_transform set to False
generate_dot_graph_after_transform: generate a DOT graph representation of random variables using BMGInference to_dot with after_transform set to True
